description: The implementer's correction after the pre-PR review and the publication of the work: a disposition for every finding, the correction, the pushed branch and head, the pull request opened from it and the ticket transition

dispositions.description: Exactly one item for each finding of the pre-PR review contracts in request.feedback.refs, identified by that contract's role and the finding's id; empty when they have no findings

review.description: The role of the review contract the finding is in

id.description: The finding's id in that review contract

action.description: fixed: changed in a commit of this Step. not_fixed: left as it is

reason.description: Why the finding was fixed this way or left as it is

correction.description: committed: this Step committed in the worktree, so head is a new commit after the implement contract's local_head. no_change: it committed nothing, so head is that local_head

branch.description: The branch of the input's repository that was pushed and is the pull request's head, without refs/heads/

head.description: The worktree HEAD after the last commit, which is the commit pushed to branch

pull_request.description: The pull request opened from branch, as GitHub shows it

ticket_transition.description: The ticket transition and its actual result; the Controller does not check it

ticket.description: The ticket of the implement contract

target.description: The status the ticket was moved to, or was to be moved to

status.description: done: the ticket was transitioned. failed: the transition was attempted and did not happen. not_done: no transition was attempted

detail.description: What was done and its result, or why it failed or was not attempted
